answers.core:
Since "Horizontal Vector 2 Editing" is already a thing, which means there's a possibility that this can also be easily done.
I don't think it's a bad choice to be included into the engine as a default option, instead of having to make an add-on for very minor thing.
answers.workaround:
If there's a detailed documentation on how to advance-customize the exporting method, specially on the design for the input field, then `exports` properties can be solved. But there's no way to customize default properties. (Button text label, for example)
Alternatively, is to expand the inspector dock. There's a proposal for a new automated width https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/41369 , but that still requires user to expand it initially.
